title: What binds to T&& (slides 168–169)
expectedStdout:
crg = 8, rd = 8, k3 = 10, k4 = 10
f5 got temporary 5
f5 got temporary 10
f5 got std::move(j) 8
tryThis: Uncomment `f5( j );`: an lvalue doesn't bind to `int&&`.
`std::move(j)` compiles, but `j` is an `int`, so "moving" it just copies it. Moves only pay off for types that own resources.
